# Master Template - Next.js 16

> Production-ready Next.js 16 starter template with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, next-intl, Docker, and CI/CD.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, React Server Components)
- **UI & Runtime**: React 19, Base UI, Tailwind CSS v4, next-themes
- **Localization**: next-intl (English & Spanish with dynamic locale routing)
- **Code Quality**: TypeScript strict mode, ESLint (Flat config + strictTypeChecked), Prettier, Husky, Commitlint
- **DevOps**: Standalone multi-stage Docker build, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline

## Available Routes & Endpoints
- `/en`: English localized landing page
- `/es`: Spanish localized landing page
- `/api/health`: JSON health check endpoint (`{ "status": "ok" }`)
- `/sitemap.xml`: Dynamic XML sitemap with multilingual hreflang and x-default support
- `/robots.txt`: Search engine crawling directives
- `/.well-known/security.txt`: RFC 9116 security vulnerability disclosure policy
